page.overview:
Who is Architect?

The Architect (her first name is never revealed) is a woman in the Simpson family.

She appears when Homer tries to showcase how successful his family is. She is employed as an architect.

The Architect Relative later appears in "Catch 'Em if You Can" in a flashback of Uncle Tyrone's birthday the previous year.
